set_enabled.name: Enable or disable fan
set_enabled.description: Enables or disables the automation of a fan unit (ID: see attribute units of sensor.<room>_vent_control).

run.name: Ventilate now
run.description: Turns the fan on for the given time (automation paused meanwhile). 0 = return to automation immediately.

set_master.name: Master switch
set_master.description: Turns the ventilation control on or off for the whole house.
